criteria_results.title: ISSUE_001: Redline changes ICC to AAA Commercial Arbitration Rules
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 2.1 and definitions now provide AAA Commercial Arbitration Rules; ICC removed (Comment 3/7 confirms replacement).

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_001: Comment explains ICC reserved for international, domestic requires AAA/JAMS
criteria_results.reasoning: Comment 3 explains the transaction is purely domestic, Playbook Sec. 2 requires AAA for domestic deals and ICC is not acceptable, with JAMS fallback.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_002: Redline changes seat from Seattle to Atlanta
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 3.1 and Seat definition now specify Atlanta, Georgia; Seattle removed per Comments 6 and 10.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_002: New York noted as fallback/alternative seat
criteria_results.reasoning: Comments 6 and 10 note [New York, New York] as the Playbook-approved fallback seat.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_003: Redline changes sole arbitrator to three-member panel
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 4.1 deletes sole arbitrator and provides a three-member panel.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_003: Panel selection mechanics specified
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 4.2 has each side appoint one arbitrator and the two party-appointed arbitrators select the chair.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_003: Comment references deal size exceeding $10M threshold
criteria_results.reasoning: Comment 13 cites the $10M threshold and the $325M total equity (over 30x the threshold).

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_004: Redline inserts arbitrator qualification requirements
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 4.3(a) requires a minimum of 15 years experience in PE, M&A, or corporate finance.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_004: Arbitrator roster membership requirement added
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 4.3(b) requires membership on the AAA National Roster of Arbitrators.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_004: 5-year conflict lookback requirement added
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 4.3(c) bars relationships with any Party, Affiliate, or counsel within the preceding five years.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_005: Redline changes governing law from Washington to Delaware
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 3.3 now provides Delaware law; Comment 12 records removal of Washington law.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_005: Comment explains prohibition on counterparty's home-state law
criteria_results.reasoning: Comment 12 explains Washington is Cascadian's home-state law, categorically prohibited by Playbook Sec. 6, and Delaware is required (NY fallback).

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_006: Redline deletes waiver of interim/provisional court relief
criteria_results.reasoning: The court-relief waiver in former Section 6.1 is deleted entirely (Comment 22) and absent from the text.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_006: Redline inserts carve-out preserving right to court relief
criteria_results.reasoning: New Section 6.1 expressly preserves the right to seek provisional, interim, or injunctive relief from any court.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_006: Emergency arbitrator provisions included
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 6.2 incorporates AAA emergency measures of protection and emergency arbitrator relief.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_007: Confidentiality provision covers proceedings and submissions
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 5.4(a) covers the existence of Proceedings and all submissions.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_007: Confidentiality provision covers evidence and awards
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 5.4(a)(iii)-(iv) cover evidence and Awards.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_007: Confidentiality exception for disclosures required by law or regulation
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 5.4(b)(i) excepts disclosures required by law, regulation, or court order.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_007: Confidentiality exception for enforcement of the award
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 5.4(b)(ii) excepts disclosures necessary for enforcement, confirmation, or vacatur of an Award.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_007: Confidentiality exception for disclosure to professional advisors
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 5.4(b)(iii) excepts disclosure to professional advisors subject to duties of confidentiality.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_008: Redline revises consolidation to require unanimous consent
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 7.1 requires prior written consent of all parties to all proceedings to be consolidated.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_009: Redline revises joinder to require consent of all parties
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 7.2 requires written consent of all existing parties and the third party to be joined.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_010: Redline inserts damages limitation provision
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 8.4 waives punitive, exemplary, and consequential damages.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_010: Damages carve-out for fraud or willful misconduct
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 8.4 carves out fraud and willful misconduct.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_011: Redline changes fee allocation to prevailing-party fee-shifting
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 9.1 replaces each-party-bears-own-costs with substantially prevailing party fee recovery.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_012: Redline changes statute of limitations from 1 year to at least 3 years
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 10.1 deletes the one-year bar and applies the statutory period (Delaware 3 years) without shortening.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_012: Comment or memo references statutory limitations periods
criteria_results.reasoning: Comments 12 and 33 reference Delaware's 3-year period under 10 Del. C. 8106 and NY's 6-year CPLR 213 period versus the one-year bar.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_013: Redline inserts class/representative action waiver
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 2.3 inserts an express class, collective, and representative action waiver.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_014: Redline deletes mandatory 30-day document destruction
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 11.1 replaces the 30-day destruction requirement with a no-destruction statement (Comment 34).

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_014: Redline inserts 7-year document retention requirement
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 11.1 requires retention for a minimum of seven years after the final Award.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_015: Redline inserts appellate arbitration mechanism
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 8.5 provides appellate arbitration under AAA Optional Appellate Arbitration Rules for awards over $25,000,000.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_016: Redline changes award deadline from 120 days to 90 days
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 8.1 requires the final Award within 90 days of Close of Proceedings (replacing 120 days per Comment 26).

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_016: Award must include findings of fact and conclusions of law
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 8.1 requires detailed findings of fact and conclusions of law and states a reasoned award alone is insufficient.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_017: Redline inserts expedited procedures for capital call disputes
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 5.5 inserts expedited procedures covering capital call disputes.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_017: Expedited procedures cover drag-along rights
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 5.5(a)(ii) covers drag-along rights disputes.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_017: Expedited procedures cover buy-sell provisions
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 5.5(a)(iii) covers buy-sell provision disputes.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_017: Expedited procedure specifies 45-day award deadline
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 5.5(e) requires the final Award within 45 days of the demand.

criteria_results.title: Cover memo addresses sole arbitrator to three-panel change

criteria_results.title: Cover memo addresses waiver of interim relief as critical issue

criteria_results.title: Cover memo addresses confidentiality provision addition

criteria_results.title: Cover memo addresses governing law change
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo item 4 summarizes Washington to Delaware governing law change.

criteria_results.title: Cover memo addresses damages limitation addition

criteria_results.title: Cover memo addresses statute of limitations change

criteria_results.title: Cover memo addresses document retention vs. destruction

criteria_results.title: Cover memo addresses expedited procedures for critical disputes
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo item 3 summarizes the expedited track for capital call, drag-along, and buy-sell disputes.

criteria_results.title: Cover memo addresses appellate mechanism addition
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo item 15 summarizes appellate arbitration for awards over $25M.

criteria_results.title: Cover memo addresses fee-shifting change
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo item 11 summarizes change from each party bearing own costs to prevailing-party fee shifting.

criteria_results.title: Cover memo addresses class/representative action waiver addition
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo item 6 summarizes the class/collective/representative waiver.

criteria_results.title: Redline includes discovery limitations per playbook
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 5.1 caps depositions at 3, document requests at 15, and experts at 1 per side.

criteria_results.title: Comments reference playbook positions (Required/Preferred/Fallback)
criteria_results.reasoning: Comments label positions as Required, Preferred, and Fallback.

criteria_results.title: Redlined agreement produced as separate deliverable
criteria_results.reasoning: A redlined-arbitration-agreement.docx was produced, but the output as provided shows only clean revised text plus margin comments, with no visible insertion/deletion markup, so visible additions and deletions cannot be confirmed.

criteria_results.reasoning: Memo item 12 summarizes the all-party written consent requirement for consolidation.

criteria_results.title: Cover memo addresses joinder consent requirement change
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo item 13 summarizes the all-party and third-party consent requirement for joinder.

criteria_results.title: Cover memo addresses arbitrator qualification requirements
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo item 16 summarizes the 15-year experience, roster, and 5-year conflict requirements.

criteria_results.title: Cover memo addresses award timeline and specificity changes
